metaTitle: Stucco Repair in Northwest Calgary | Sandstone Stucco Co
metaDescription: Stucco repair in Northwest Calgary: cracks, hail damage, flicker holes and parging on 1990s-2000s homes. No-obligation quotes. Email or call (403) 555-0148.
heroSub: Cracks, hail dents, flicker holes and tired parging on the 1990s and 2000s stucco homes of Northwest Calgary. Describe your wall and get a no-obligation quote from an independent contractor.
introHtml:
Stucco repair in Northwest Calgary mostly means houses from the 1990s and 2000s. The City of Calgary labels Citadel, Edgemont, Hawkwood and Scenic Acres as 1980s and 1990s communities, and Arbour Lake, Hamptons, Rocky Ridge and Tuscany as 2000s ones. By those labels, many of the walls here have been through well over a decade of Calgary winters.

Sandstone Stucco Co is an advertising and introduction service. It puts you in touch with independent stucco contractors who quote and contract directly with you, and it is paid by those contractors. Read the stucco repair overview for how it works, then call (403) 555-0148 or send the form to describe your wall.

services.title: Cracks, patches and colour matching
services.desc: Chips, hairline cracks and small patches. Calgary Parging lists $550 to $1,125 before GST for small patch repairs, and says colour matching can add $230 to $575. On a weathered finish a perfect match may not be possible.

services.title: Hail and flicker damage
services.desc: Hail pocking and holes drilled by northern flickers, looked at on the wall itself. Calgary Parging lists a typical single-woodpecker patch with reinforcement at $600 to $800 (GST not stated). A contractor can put hail damage in a written estimate you may give your insurer.

services.title: Foundation parging
services.desc: Recoating and patching the cement coat at the base of the wall. Calgary Parging lists $975 to $1,700 before GST to recoat one side of a house. This is surface coating only; a crack in the foundation itself is a question for a foundation specialist.

services.title: Re-stucco and recoat
services.desc: Larger areas, or a whole elevation, when a patch will not do. Martini Stone Masonry lists $14,350 before GST for one elevation stripped to the face and refinished in acrylic. Whether repair or replacement fits is the contractor's call after seeing the wall.

sections.heading: What the NW Calgary housing stock means for your walls
sections.html:
The City's era labels put Citadel, Edgemont, Hawkwood and Scenic Acres in the 1980s and 1990s, and Arbour Lake, Hamptons, Rocky Ridge and Tuscany in the 2000s. Census 2021 figures show the pattern: in Tuscany, 28% of dwellings were built 1991 to 2000 and 64% were built 2001 to 2010. Varsity, a 1960s and 1970s community, has 68% of its dwellings built 1961 to 1980.

Homes of that age sit outside the New Home Buyer Protection Act, which applies only to homes built under a building permit applied for on or after 1 February 2014. If your home is newer than that, check your new home warranty before paying for repairs. Hail damage is not a defect, so do not assume a warranty covers it.

Calgary Parging said in 2024 that cement stucco with an acrylic finish is its go-to product on over 87% of the residential properties it works on, its own job mix rather than a city survey. Its guide also says stucco is designed to deflect water, not to be waterproof, and that over 30% of its residential repairs address water damage from incorrectly installed gutters, eaves or flashing. Cracks around windows and low on the wall are worth showing a contractor early for that reason.

sections.heading: Hail, insurance and flickers
sections.html:
The City of Calgary says the city sits in "hail alley" and that all communities are equally exposed to hail. The 13 June 2020 storm hit Calgary, Airdrie, Rocky View County and the surrounding area (IBC), with insured losses of almost $1.2 billion at first, later about $1.3 billion across 63,000 claims (Environment and Climate Change Canada). ECCC put its hail core over northeastern Calgary, and IBC said the 5 August 2024 storm primarily affected northern parts of the city. A hail core covers only part of the city, so look at your own wall rather than assuming.

IBC says hail damage is typically covered by home insurance policies, so check your own policy. The City's advice is to contact your home insurance provider before any repair work. IBC's steps include photographing the damage, calling your insurer's claims department and keeping receipts. A contractor can give you a written repair estimate to pass to your insurer; this site does not file, manage or negotiate claims. More on the hail and woodpecker damage page.

Northern flickers are protected under the federal Migratory Birds Convention Act, so do not harm them or disturb a hole with eggs or chicks in it. Calgary Parging says flickers work Calgary stucco hard, especially on west and south elevations in spring. Non-harmful measures such as covering the area with wire mesh are allowed, and an empty hole can be repaired once nesting has ended.

sections.heading: Seasons, permits and contracts before you hire
sections.html:
Calgary had 117 freeze-thaw cycles and 54 chinook days in 2022, and the City notes that moisture and snow can cause stucco to shrink and crack. Stucco work has temperature limits: Imasco says no stucco work below 4 degrees C for 24 hours before, during and after application, and Calgary Parging says stucco cures best above 5 degrees C, typically April through October, with heated hoarding needed off-season. A winter visit for photos and a written scope is still worth doing, so the job is ready when the weather allows.

The City says most repair or replacement work does not need a development or building permit. Like-for-like siding needs none, while siding in a different material needs a building permit, and it is worth confirming your project with the City on 311. Alberta.ca advises a written contract, written estimates from more than one business and Workers' Compensation Board coverage, and the City says to call 311 to check a contractor's business licence. A contractor who takes money before the work is finished and sells in person away from its own premises needs an Alberta prepaid contracting licence, which you can check with Service Alberta.

This page is an advertisement. Sandstone Stucco Co is paid by the contractors it introduces, does no stucco work itself and holds no licence, insurance or warranty of its own. The contractor who quotes your job is the one you contract with, and the Calgary stucco repair cost guide shows what named firms publish.

faq.q: Does a new home warranty cover stucco problems on an older NW Calgary house?
faq.a: Probably not by that route. The New Home Buyer Protection Act applies only to homes built under a building permit applied for on or after 1 February 2014, and requires at least 5 years of cover for building envelope defects. A 1990s or 2000s house in a community like Citadel or Tuscany predates that. If your home is newer, check your warranty before paying, and note that hail damage is not a defect.

faq.q: Did the June 2020 hailstorm hit Northwest Calgary?
faq.a: IBC says the 13 June 2020 storm affected Calgary, Airdrie, Rocky View County and the surrounding area, and Environment and Climate Change Canada says the hail core scraped over northeastern Calgary. This site has no primary source naming damaged NW communities, so it does not say which streets were hit. The City says all communities are equally exposed, so check your own wall and your own policy.

faq.q: How much does a small stucco repair cost in Northwest Calgary?
faq.a: There is no NW-specific price. Calgary Parging lists $550 to $1,125 before GST for small patch repairs, with a minimum service call of $550 to $690, also before GST. Those are one firm's published figures, not quotes from this site. The contractor who quotes your job sets the price after seeing the wall.

faq.q: A flicker keeps drilling into my wall in spring. What can I do?
faq.a: The northern flicker is federally protected, so do not harm it or disturb a hole with eggs or chicks. Environment and Climate Change Canada says access can be cut off with a tarp or wire mesh as long as the bird is not disturbed or harmed, and the Regulations allow non-harmful scare devices. Once nesting has ended, a contractor can repair the empty holes; Calgary Parging lists a typical single-woodpecker patch at $600 to $800, GST not stated.
